component.name: RustQL
component.summary: Fast, native client for MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL

description.p: RustQL is a desktop client for MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL written in Rust. It starts instantly, stays responsive with large tables and keeps your passwords in the system keyring.

ul.li: Several connections open at once, each in its own colour-coded tab
Browse databases, tables and views and edit rows directly in the grid
SQL editor with syntax highlighting, run selection and query cancellation
Export databases or tables to SQL files or straight to another server
